decisions.summary: Bookends row 4: no timing pair at batch 4's close because its engine code (types.json band, compound.py draft, the roundtrip gen, pack_audit's coverage floor) is off the pair's path
decisions.why: narrows FR-003's literal 'one timing pair' and SC-002's 'its pair band recorded and audited', and supersedes the previous record's B4-open ('bookends owed at the close'). Premise MEASURED, not taken on trust: the pair is make perf (perf_snapshot rolls the reference hamlet via hamletgen); importing hamletgen, its driver and plan loads 245 l7r modules and none of compound, compound_model, compound_parts, pack_audit or buildings.types; no file under hamletgen/ or settlement/ imports them or reads types.json. So the pair would time byte-identical code at both ends: by construction it cannot detect any regression this batch made, and its band could only be load noise - which, read as band 3, FR-003 would send to the GM as a sign-off on nothing. The rule's purpose cannot be served on this batch. Condition: this holds only while a batch's engine code stays off the hamlet roll path; a batch touching code the pair rolls takes its pair
